_readme: Every post ends with exactly 1 CTA from this list (meta.json cta_type). The goal is capturing information: comments, form fills, bookings, sign-ups. Instagram captions can't link, so IG uses 'link in bio' or a comment keyword.

comment-keyword.label: Comment KEYWORD, we DM the freebie
comment-keyword.captures: comment + DM thread, then email when we send the freebie

free-quote.label: Free quote with your top AI opportunities
free-quote.captures: name, company, work email, phone, WMS, orders per day, pain points

calculator.label: Lost-revenue / hidden-cost calculator, then free quote
calculator.captures: same form as free-quote, warmer intent

office-hours.label: Free group office hours, bring your bottleneck

newsletter.label: Newsletter sign-up
newsletter.note: Form lives in the site footer. A dedicated /newsletter page would convert better.

workshop.label: The AI Employee Accelerator, live on Zoom
workshop.share: Evergreen: never put a date or time in copy or media. CTA is the comment-keyword WORKSHOP (lead post) plus 'check the link in our bio for the next date' (LinkedIn: profile).
workshop.note: next_date is internal only (for the bio link page and DMs), never quoted in posts.

leadMagnets._readme: Freebies promised by comment-keyword posts. status 'to-build' means it must exist before the post is approved; 'manual' means there's no file, we answer the DM by hand.

items.name: 3PL billing leak checklist
items.note: Also sent for SYSTEMS on 3PL posts (video "Your warehouse did the work. The invoice never saw it").

items.name: Agent-ready store check (what AI shopping assistants look for before they buy)
items.note: SYSTEMS is shared: send this on e-commerce posts, the 3PL billing leak checklist on 3PL posts.

items.name: AI Employee Starter Pack: 5 starter skills (/inbox-triage, /meeting-prep, /follow-up-writer, /weekly-numbers, /sop-writer) plus the permission sheet
items.note: Also sent for SYSTEMS on ig-company-fri-1500-sops-portable-stopmotion (caption promises "the 5 skills we install first"). On the 2 SOP posts it goes out with the SOP-to-skill sheet. WORKSHOP DMs also send this pack. The PDF names the 5 skill folders in the zip.

items.name: Approval sheet: 4 things AI should never send without your yes
items.note: Callout points to both contentsystems.ai/logistics and /ecommerce (refunds and customer emails plus freight bookings).

items.name: Peak invoice check: 6 lines for carrier and 3PL invoices before Black Friday
AI helper owner sheet: every AI helper needs an owner
Support handoff map: 5 moments a support bot must hand to a person
Agent-ready check for brands and 3PLs (what an AI shopping assistant reads, and who owns each fact)
items.note: Different from the W43 agent-ready store checklist: this 1 splits each fact between brand and warehouse. Callout also lists contentsystems.ai/logistics.

items.name: SOP-to-skill sheet: turn 1 SOP into an AI skill (template plus worked example)
items.next_step: Follow @koredekola, comment AI for the Starter Pack
items.note: Sent together with the AI Employee Starter Pack on the SOPs-are-portable posts. No company selling (ig-personal rule).

items.name: Next AI workshop: details + sign-up link
items.delivery: sent by DM (no file); reply with the next date and the contentsystems.ai/workshop link
items.note: Evergreen workshop CTA (Korede, 2026-10-24): comment WORKSHOP + next date in bio; posts never mention a date. From 2026-10-24 the WORKSHOP DM also sends the AI Employee Starter Pack (assets/freebies/ai-employee-starter-pack.pdf), so workshop covers can promise a free starter pack.

items.name: 4 skills that fix AI that feels mid: /context-pack, /draft-only, /sop-to-skill, /self-check
items.note: Keyword AI on this post sends this bundle plus the starter pack.

items.name: 5 skills, 1 per AI take: /confidence-check, /draft-only, /context-pack, /tool-audit, /plan-first
items.note: Keyword AI on this post sends this bundle plus the starter pack.

leadMagnets._skills: Skill folders live in assets/freebies/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; zipped bundles in assets/freebies/bundles/. Send every file listed in "send".

offers._readme: The 6 packaged offers from the LinkedIn banner (Oct 2026). Rotate CTAs across them; match the offer to the post's audience.

ai-partner.label: Your AI Partner
ai-partner.promise: Apps, sites and AI, built for you

company-brain.label: The second brain (product name)
company-brain.note: Product is branded 'second brain' but house style bans the phrase. Say 'company brain' in copy until Korede decides.
